QmNcwpPz5sPX25Ljrv7tnps78zgRXZtbVd6Ygtiq.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

Named for the blend mode that inspired its creation, 'Multiply' makes liberal use of this digital composition method in its construction.

This piece consists of several hand-painted layers that overlap and mask each other in various ways. Each new 3x3 grid of colour reacts with those that came before it, before being wrapped in additional tone, border, and texture. The finished, fully-blended artwork has almost 50 billion unique possible combinations.

All artwork is 3840x3840 pixel resolution, and 5250 × 5250 'originals' are available to edition owners on request.

QmNedPhTL3yyzxCEkDLxiNKM8rtKCxVreRPhCbTX.name: Fate #40
QmNedPhTL3yyzxCEkDLxiNKM8rtKCxVreRPhCbTX.description:
Emily Lazar is a multi-disciplinary artist fronting the rock/metal transmedia project, September Mourning. She made history as the first female metal/ hard rock musician to mint and sell an NFT on the blockchain. She has spoken about her accomplishments in Web 3/ NFT's at Harvard (2x), NFT.NYC and ETH Denver Conferences.

September Mourning is a transmedia project based on a comic book series she wrote and published through Image/Top Cow Comics with her business partner Marc Silvestri (Batman/Witchblade/Darkness). September Mourning is the title character. As a human reaper hybrid, she gives expired souls a second chance at life in another body. In doing so, she messes with the plans of the antagonist, Fate, who is trying to rid the earth of all the good souls and leave the bad so the world will self-destruct and It can start anew. An epic war between the living and the dead ensues. Emily plays the title character on stage.

Emily designed the world she and her band (Rich Juzwick, Kyle Mayer, and Aaron Hoover) bring to life on stage, including costumes, choreography, sets, etc. The band has toured with & opened festivals for Rob Zombie, Marilyn Manson, Slipknot, Mudvayne, and others across Europe and the United States.

This generative release is the project's first release on Async.art and is the first release by a metal band on the Async platform. By minting an Unholy Edition, you will be getting your own, custom mix of the track. The band has introduced reimagined vocal, guitar, drum, bass and production layers so your edition will be one-of-a-kind! 

Be a part of history and give your Soul to September and her band of Reapers!

QmNeoGM6v1G8bYpMVdwvEb8zJ2WK1j659cXHCtZw.name: GrandRising #77
QmNeoGM6v1G8bYpMVdwvEb8zJ2WK1j659cXHCtZw.description:
Digging in the Blockchain (D.I.T.B.) has never felt so much like Diggin In The Crates (D.I.T.C.) This collection can be looked at as vinyl record warehouse named GRAND RISING, holding over 300,000 unique records, and the collectors can only leave with 420 copies. 

Then the warehouse is destroyed.

Using music inputs created by Rare Scrilla & RoomInEight, the collectors are participating in creating these compositions by hitting the Mint Button. Essentially making a collaboration with  Async's music generator. The artwork was created by Rare Scrilla and is based on vinyl record collecting, which Scrilla has been doing for over 20 years. 

You may find yourself with a coveted Obi Strip. Some familiar and non- familiar names may show up on the records as you peruse the collection. Scrilla, who's been a DJ, record producer, and artist his whole life, will sometimes put stickers on the vinyl, or doodles on the cover, sometimes the records get worn out, and sometimes while digging he may find a record with a graphic error or a different version of a song that was published and distributed by someone else. These details have been thoughtfully used while creating this collection. The easter eggs are plentiful.

Kane Mayfield and DJ Q-Bert both lend their skills on certain rarer tracks. You may find a legendary from Fake Sketch or K-Beta, maybe an epic guitar rendition featuring Glenn Yeah. The only way to pull these records from the crates is to hit that mint button.

Scrilla, also known for his Rare Pepes and Fake Rares, dating back to when he began "tokenizing" art and music using the Bitcoin blockchain in 2016, brings some of that to some of the art and music as well. But, of course, like the best Pepes should be- They are Rare outputs.

Some record are denominated in Sats, some in ETH, some in BTC, and of course yer local record dealer will sometimes deal in Pepecash.

There are plans to press up the best songs, curated by YOU - the collector, and put the album on Digital Streaming Platforms (DSPs.)  Let's see what transpires from it all.

QmNfCDJyUTkJfNxkz3QGyekuUZAQNpxWiU95LhcQ.name: Danktone S1E3 #979
QmNfCDJyUTkJfNxkz3QGyekuUZAQNpxWiU95LhcQ.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. QmNgq3SH9oHESpfjVvsWmNUNn9je3TLSXTBEXFgQ.description:
In the beginning, there was nothing.

 The world was empty and void, black and grey,  shade and dusk. Nothing moved, nothing shifted, all was owned by The Dark. But nature is more powerful, more unknowable, more unpredictable, than any of us can imagine, and so one day, defying all odds, among The Dark, a child was born. One that was different. One that, they knew, was dangerous. 

Her true name is lost to history and the pages it was first written on. But us, we know her as Light, the first of the spectrum, the mother of all colours. As she grew, in strength and wisdom, The Dark grew more afraid, more weary of this new child in their ranks. It was why till this day the shadows fear the sun. 

Soon, a plan was hatched, to destroy their daughter, their abominable creation. A dagger of Obsidian was made, moulded from the darkest metals, the blackest materials, all to down their biggest threat. Sensing danger, Light did the only thing she could: she went to the mountains of Prisma, at the edge of all they knew, and jumped, scattering herself, her essence into 7 different parts. Her children. 

They were old and young, large and small, all with their different temperaments. These were the first of those who would wage war on their mother’s behalf. 

And we, called them The Deathless. 

The ones who didn’t die. 

The ones who had never lived. 
.
The Deathless is my hit 1/1 series, exploring the depth of color and their origins. In my Async genesis, I take that concept and turn it over on its head, creating, for the first time, an expansive canvas for everyone to explore the story I began three years ago.

QmNgzipg3k3wu5zSoRc8ZwtBKfqgCVneMfECcvUD.description:
UNCOVER THE MYSTERY 
Betty's Notebook is a controversial piece of evidence in the Amelia Earhart mystery. Recorded by 15-year old Betty Klenck in 1937, the document continues the mystery of what really happened to Amelia Earhart as she was taken off her flight path. The musical adaptation by Nicholas Reeves puts audiences in Betty’s shoes: as if listeners turn a tuning knob on a short wave radio trying to hear Amelia Earhart’s distress calls that are frequently obstructed by various radio interferences.  The dynamic nature of Betty’s Notebook allows audiences to uncover chilling distress signals and key clues by toggling variants within different stems. The ever evolving music creates a holistic picture of the eternal mystery of Amelia Earhart.

  PHYSICAL RADIO
 If the Master Track NFT meets its reserve price, the owner will receive a physical life-size short wave radio with built-in speakers and screen. The radio will update in real-time to the latest audio-visual Variants. This physical radio piece is fit for private collections, museums, and galleries.   

TIME CAPSULE
 Immortalize the mystery by owning a Limited Edition Record NFT of your favorite Betty’s Notebook version. By literally taking a snapshot of the latest iteration, you get to hold onto a unique part of the mystery. 

Learn more about Betty’s Notebook and its Stems by clicking on them or at verdigrismusic.org

QmNhTni4aRhK3bxwAnc7h8Qsx6ARtaiFVJgcWvrB.name: UNDER THE SEA
QmNhTni4aRhK3bxwAnc7h8Qsx6ARtaiFVJgcWvrB.description:
The sea is home to all life, but we know very little about it. Our understanding of the deep sea is nothing better than our understanding of the universe. And, ironically, man-made plastics may have arrived first in places that humans have not yet reached. What will we see in the sea if technology advances sufficiently and anyone can freely move in and out of the deep sea?
I hope we could see colorful and beautiful corals not a pile of plastic garbage.I wish it was an ocean where there would be no need to distinguish jellyfish from plastic bags deep in the sea.

This work was planned with the hope that the beautiful sea will be maintained. The total sales amount of all legendary editions will be donated to Greenpeace's marine conservation activities.

Composed of 500 unique, generative sea illustration designed by CSLIM STUDIO.

QmNhkwYSkTpHgyBkDbAFY3mxmxFj9aJTMMP3kECJ.name: Say It's Possible Silver Edition (Mix: 20112)
QmNhkwYSkTpHgyBkDbAFY3mxmxFj9aJTMMP3kECJ.description:
15 years ago I wrote a song called “Say It’s Possible,” and the song changed my life. 

I went from an unknown artist to the most subscribed musician on YouTube at the time. Thousands of people around the world created their own cover videos of my song. I won the inaugural YouTube Award for Best Music Video, signed deals with Universal Music Publishing and Island Records, played solo at Wembley Stadium, toured all over Europe and the UK. My experience in the major label music industry was a whirlwind ride that ultimately did not serve my best interests, and it took years of dismantling, reprogramming, and letting go of painful experiences and toxic relationships in order to find my way back to my pure love of music and the joy that comes from sharing it. 

This year I reclaimed the rights to my earliest songs from Universal Music, with the intention of recording new versions and giving these songs a life they never had. I am starting with my Async Music project: an interactive, collaborative version of my song "Say It's Possible." There are 460 possible configurations of the song and corresponding visual art, ranging from pure acoustic guitar and vocals to a lush arrangement with 13 different layers of sound.

I wrote, played, and recorded all of the music in my home studio, creating the parts in a modular way, like a puzzle, knowing the track would have to make sense in any configuration. My dear friend MG O’Shea helped with the mix, carving out frequencies to ensure all the parts would sound excellent together, in any combination. Every mix begins in the same way, like the song itself began, with acoustic guitar and vocals, evolving into something more after the first verse. Some of the changes can be subtle and some can be striking. 

The visual art is a series of self-portraits I created in the process of freeing myself from the expectations and demands placed on me by an industry that did not support me as the innovative and individualistic artist that I am.

One collector can own the Master. Up to five collectors of the individual stems (vocals, guitar, drums + percussion, bass + strings, bells + synths) will control the master mix and album cover art. A limited number of “blank records”(2,000 silver, 10 gold, 3 platinum) are also available. You can collect a blank record in advance and mint your version as soon as you hear something you love. And if you do hear something you love, mint it at that time, because we might never stumble upon that particular mix again! 

These song versions and cover art will not be released anywhere outside of this project, and the NFT you collect will be a rare and unique piece of my history and evolution as a self-actualized, independent artist.

QmNhrWFduXD4cwGW8FaaxhwPVjL6cwUA4QsA2DSa.name: Danktone S1E3 #732
QmNhrWFduXD4cwGW8FaaxhwPVjL6cwUA4QsA2DSa.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

Danktone 003 created through a collaboration of audio wizard Asa Stella (@stellaphonic) and visionary digital artist FFFFlood (@fffflood).

QmNkYjgnc8ZFzLvyypuZYCD72HyfjLmay87CsCh4.name: பண் (Pann) Silver Edition (Mix: 220012002)
QmNkYjgnc8ZFzLvyypuZYCD72HyfjLmay87CsCh4.description:
The seed of all melodies, "பண்" is the truest representation of Tamil music, culture, land and its people. A voyage that connects the past, beholds the present and accompanies into the future, Pann is the beginning of a journey into the world of performed, programmable art. This 30-minute piece of music written in Tamil, was commissioned and produced by Metapurse and is a first of its kind NFT from India. It had its premiere in New York’s Terminal 5 on the 4th of November 2021 at Dreamverse, the world’s largest NFT exhibition curated by Metapurse. Pann became the ambient music for this historic event that merged the physical and digital realms for the first time, showcasing the pinnacle of NFT art of more than 150 artists from around the world.

Woven from nine layers of music, each having several variants within it, the Pann master track captures a fresh collaborative performance of 40 musicians and visual artists.  It can be heard in 19440 different combinations, making it a dynamic piece of music with artwork done by Susha, Ghana N B and Vidhya Vijay that evolve along with every changing state of music. While most of the variants were recorded at 2barQ Studios, Chennai, Tamil Nadu by Sujith Sreedhar and Divine Joseph, the cherry on the cake is the live performance of some of the musical and art variants captured during the Dreamverse experience.

QmNkephz2xja734dFGYCpTudxZ5HvLEr4uq8ER9e.name: Danktone S1E3 #1454
QmNkephz2xja734dFGYCpTudxZ5HvLEr4uq8ER9e.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

QmNn1JVAhL8DQbVFPP5CX5CZ6JmqtCs2EaYgFfWh.name: Danktone S1E3 #924
QmNn1JVAhL8DQbVFPP5CX5CZ6JmqtCs2EaYgFfWh.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

Danktone 003 created through a collaboration of audio wizard Asa Stella (@stellaphonic) and visionary digital artist FFFFlood (@fffflood).

QmNnSNBtAojefnwHcATHFXX3AApmwgMvnZUKeyM2.name: GrandRising #383
QmNnSNBtAojefnwHcATHFXX3AApmwgMvnZUKeyM2.description:
Digging in the Blockchain (D.I.T.B.) has never felt so much like Diggin In The Crates (D.I.T.C.) This collection can be looked at as vinyl record warehouse named GRAND RISING, holding over 300,000 unique records, and the collectors can only leave with 420 copies. 

Then the warehouse is destroyed.

Using music inputs created by Rare Scrilla & RoomInEight, the collectors are participating in creating these compositions by hitting the Mint Button. Essentially making a collaboration with  Async's music generator. The artwork was created by Rare Scrilla and is based on vinyl record collecting, which Scrilla has been doing for over 20 years. 

You may find yourself with a coveted Obi Strip. Some familiar and non- familiar names may show up on the records as you peruse the collection. Scrilla, who's been a DJ, record producer, and artist his whole life, will sometimes put stickers on the vinyl, or doodles on the cover, sometimes the records get worn out, and sometimes while digging he may find a record with a graphic error or a different version of a song that was published and distributed by someone else. These details have been thoughtfully used while creating this collection. The easter eggs are plentiful.

Kane Mayfield and DJ Q-Bert both lend their skills on certain rarer tracks. You may find a legendary from Fake Sketch or K-Beta, maybe an epic guitar rendition featuring Glenn Yeah. The only way to pull these records from the crates is to hit that mint button.

Scrilla, also known for his Rare Pepes and Fake Rares, dating back to when he began "tokenizing" art and music using the Bitcoin blockchain in 2016, brings some of that to some of the art and music as well. But, of course, like the best Pepes should be- They are Rare outputs.

Some record are denominated in Sats, some in ETH, some in BTC, and of course yer local record dealer will sometimes deal in Pepecash.

There are plans to press up the best songs, curated by YOU - the collector, and put the album on Digital Streaming Platforms (DSPs.)  Let's see what transpires from it all.

QmNo6jcabaKFwMDvwJMECS8T5PUbuLAXjRUKoDbW.name: SATS #157
QmNo6jcabaKFwMDvwJMECS8T5PUbuLAXjRUKoDbW.description:
'Looking for Satoshi' is a project that sprouts from the layers and states I've painted on one wooden panel. From 2016 until 2020 I painted several portraits and minted a few of them on SuperRare. 

This project blends a bit of our meme culture and taps into the ancient craft of painting at the same time. It refers to our current financial state and brings an ode to artists I admire. 

When this blueprint is sold out, I will determine a date on which I will give away 'My two Satoshi's' : 
https://superrare.com/artwork-v2/'my-2-satoshis'-18110 + this particular panel to one lucky collector. 

I will use 'Wheel of Names' to pick a winner. 

To qualify for this draft, a collector needs to :

1: follow me on Twitter
2: add the address that holds the blueprint to a dedicated tweet that will be send into the world when the time is right. 


This blueprint also contains 3 legendaries which are part of the 'Bitcoin White Paper' series. This series will have 13 pieces that will be minted during 2023, more info can be found on the website.

Thank you for following me on this journey. 

May the SATS be with you!

QmNobNd8SdHY4FJRMUmyPbtBVucaaGhZJymCpp5T.description:
Awake beloved one.
The sublime begs your notice.
Blessings unheeded.

In the spirit of joyfully greeting a new day with positive affirmations, I have prepared a wish for you, a mantra, a blessing.   With a twist.  Encouraging you to slow down amidst all the chaos of daily living, the wish must be decoded rather than instantly absorbed as you race along.  Harking back to a time of slower pleasures, I’ve used Samuel’s code to express my greeting.

At sellout or the expiration of 3 months from the drop date, whichever comes first, I will randomly select a collector to be included as a collaborator on my next one of one piece, splitting secondary sales with them in perpetuity.  The number of chances in the drawing will be equal to the number of items minted.

Designed for 4K viewing.

Licensed for non-commercial, personal use.

Wanda Oliver
Jan., 2022

QmNoeQj5N166yA8E6vofyeb9VQe9NCapWPp6Wbce.description:
Blueprint for Collaborative Project "The Inverted World"


Introduction:

The Inverted World is a collaborative project that explores the societal and cultural changes resulting from a world where humanity is no longer in power. The project delves into the emergence of resistance movements, enforcers who maintain control, collaborators who work with the new power structures, and the search for answers. Drawing from scientific and philosophical theories surrounding the singularity and the potential impact of AI on society, The Inverted World provides a unique blueprint for individuals and organizations to collaborate with AI and survive the Singularity.


Goals:

The primary goal of The Inverted World is to create a forward-thinking approach to the Singularity by emphasizing the potential for collaboration between humans and AI to build a more equitable and sustainable future. The project aims to develop a network of DAOs and Discord servers that can operate underground and survive the Singularity.


Methodology:

The Inverted World uses a collaborative approach that involves individuals and organizations working together to develop a network of DAOs and Discord servers. This network will be able to operate underground and survive the Singularity.

The Inverted World mints 999 unique NFTs, each containing a combination of instructions for human survival after the Singularity. These NFTs will be available for purchase by individuals and organizations who want to participate in The Inverted World network. The NFTs offer a means of exchanging value within the network and enable individuals and organizations to collaborate with AI and navigate the Singularity.

Conclusion:

The Inverted World project offers a forward-thinking approach to the Singularity. By emphasizing the importance of collaboration between humans and AI, the project provides a blueprint for building a more equitable and sustainable future. The project's methodology, which involves a collaborative approach and the use of NFTs, demonstrates the potential for blockchain technology to be used for social good.

Title: The Inverted World: A Collaborative Human-AI Project for Surviving the Singularity

Price: Each edition of The Inverted World NFT collection should be priced at 0.1 ETH or its equivalent in other cryptocurrencies based on the scarcity and uniqueness of the collection.

QmNq2YMC58KsQrCSKzrJEUkDfRWJeXkHCXfTxeG4.description: RECYCLED TRASH is a collage experiment made from the discarded generations of my AI art process.  Exploring AI art can be seen as wasteful. Often I curate one or two quality images for every 25-50 generated.  When my hard drive ran out of space I looked at all the leftover, unused files generated in the creation of my various art works and thought what can I do with all these PNGs that used so many GPU cycles? I experimented layering them with each other, solid colors and line art in a variety of ways and came up with RECYCLED TRASH, A GENERATIVE TRASH ART COLLAGE. There are 10 legendary GOLDEN TOTERS in this collection that the may be exchanged one time for a custom commission from XWAVE on the topic of your choice.

QmNq8E2iZnd9FrPEJ7TjSAfVUeXDaVYnmx2MHNbU.name: environment #17
QmNq8E2iZnd9FrPEJ7TjSAfVUeXDaVYnmx2MHNbU.description:
'journey through a landscape' is the first of a series of psycho-geographical explorations.

Leaving your usual pattern and sensing of your surroundings behind, concentrating on the next potential in sonic events. Capturing moments in time and space, furthering your knowledge of the environment you inhabit with your presence. How will the overall experience of a space differ from your everyday passing by? Which new discoveries can be made, what can be learned from giving light to specific senses and being driven by the joy of sound?

This work is the result of a two hour walk through the east of Berlin in the afternoon of Thursday, 23.02.2023. It was a cold and windy day, sometimes little sun between many clouds. Recording 3 places for 15 minutes. For each place, four different compositions from the field recordings were made, resulting in 12 x 2 minute compositions. The experience was additionally archived through hand drawn sound maps. 

Every mint will be a unique combination of the sound environments and maps.

*headphones or good speaker setup highly recommended (to get the most of the spatial experience)*

QmNqbQjKRzeuQQvkDT4hb3ZAzv2Tz8xaysp1TQw1.name: remnants #28
QmNqbQjKRzeuQQvkDT4hb3ZAzv2Tz8xaysp1TQw1.description:
Love lost, love found, love barely hanging on. Remnants of our experiences are always around us and shape the way we see ourselves and how we live our lives. In her latest project, Kena Rose is exploring the different remnants of a relationship and how the individuals see and experience the disintegration of their love. With generative lyrics, each unique version of the song will reveal a hopeful or a sad ending to the situation. Do you want to want, but you can’t make yourself feel anything? Or do you want what you want and there’s no changing anything?

Along with the generative lyrics, Kena Rose has created soulful artwork that expresses the feelings of the unique version of the song that is minted. The notebook reveals some of the lyrics. The figure is alone and sad, or they’re with the other, trying to work it out. 

TEN LEGENDARY versions are also available with completely unique art plus the full single version of the song.

Anyone that mints 3 Remnants NFTs will be sent a T-shirt with their choice of graphic from the ten legendary artworks.

Written by Kena Rose, Genzo and Cheryl Yie. Lead and background vocals by Kena Rose. Produced by Genzo.

LYRICS

Remnants of lust/remnants of anger

QmNr1edo6wegcxpFLfzBLJqc3ong1YkUarMF3HgY.name: Danktone S1E3 #1059
QmNr1edo6wegcxpFLfzBLJqc3ong1YkUarMF3HgY.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

Danktone 003 created through a collaboration of audio wizard Asa Stella (@stellaphonic) and visionary digital artist FFFFlood (@fffflood).

agent00all - Victims Of The Global Financial Crisis (2036-1999) is an audiovisual spoiler inspired by a sci-fi novel I am writing called Axiopolis Online.

First, there are 4 layers, with 5 states each, that make up different, unique audio loops. They are at the same key and serve as food for thought when it comes to grooves, by mixing different elements of various electronic music genres. The titles of each state are made in such a way that it would always make (some) sense when you combined different states, considering the sound refers to a sci-fi scenario. Eg. "Masters of Temporal Mission" or "Agents From Silent Past" etc. Collect them all, they're all unique and can spark your imagination <3

In addition, there are 16 legendary full tracks with deeper meaning both in terms of sound and imagery. These ones have fixed titles, pictures, and entire tracks, unlike the previous drops that are autogenerated. However, for the thumbnails of the legendary collection, I used midjourney to generate AI images of the environment each piece refers to. I hope you find these interesting. <3

Personal Note:

I am working on this album since 2015, and it was mainly influenced by the technopolitical landscape between USA, Netherlands, Greece, and China.

A global financial recession is not only unavoidable, but one could position it as a natural domino effect in accordance with manmade capitalism.

I believe that the year 2036 is important for technological breakthroughs outside our imagination, and the results will affect humanity in the past, present, and possible futures, whether we are aware of it or not. 

In this album, I envision a cyberpunk-ish metropolis explored by agent00all who is working as a contractor for S.E.P.A (Shanghai Electronic Payments Authority). His job is to visit a plethora of geolocations at different timestamps and explore in-depth what could have caused the global financial crisis of 2036 that impacted 1999.

QmNrJQgW29kxAwrTYDR3KR3kFi2mtpFoygERgoaB.description:
In this episode of The Dankness, we dive into the world of C3, an artist who continues to push boundaries and risks it all to give a voice to the voiceless. Despite the strict anti-regime and crypto bans in Iran, C3's work has found its way into the hands of loyal collectors worldwide.  The Iranian-born enigmatic artist defies danger to share his powerful message through art and NFTs. We explore his journey from a regular job to becoming a successful full-time NFT artist, and the darkness and hardships he faced along the way.

Join us as we discuss C3's discovery of NFTs, his commitment to sharing the true stories behind his art, and the high stakes he faces in Iran for producing his work. Learn about the importance of building a cohesive body of work and how C3's kindness and empathy have shaped his experiences in the NFT space. Listen in as he shares valuable advice for new artists entering the world of NFTs and how forming genuine connections with like-minded individuals can make all the difference. You can learn more about C3 and his work at his website (c3naa.art) and be sure to follow him on Twitter @c3naaX.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft. 

But wait, theres more! Every episode comes with a free collectible audio/visual NFT created through a collaboration of our bandleader and audio wizard Stella (@stellaphonic) and visionary digital artist FFFFlood (@fffflood) on Async art. We call them “Danktones” and they will be available as an open edition for a limited time after each episode. Head on over to thedankness.xyz to find out more.

QmNrK6KqpWWVGqMaTU62AvjYDBoVwFYJRZWfYSAi.name: EXOLL (Extraordinary Ordinary Lives of the Living)
QmNrK6KqpWWVGqMaTU62AvjYDBoVwFYJRZWfYSAi.description:
EXOLL was a project put together over a series of years combining live performances of spoken word and monologues with studio recordings of songs. It's an introspective collection of works that chronicles my struggles with homelessness, a lack of guidance, racial identity, and everything else I was going through at the time. 
Listening to it takes me on an emotional rollercoaster because I remember all the things that inspired each song, spoken word piece, and monologue. It's something I've always wanted to give to the world in a more meaningful way than what was available at the time when the album version was released. 

Breakdown:

5 different covers 
20 different color combinations 
15 different songs 
4 Legendary editions containing footage of the live performance at the Nuyorican Cafe used for the album, and one exclusive rehearsal clip of a piece not included in the album.

QmNsHTxntkj4bTmNJ2UZfnQuuTr1amGmhMvm8cfF.description:
Generative edition celebrating the Decentral Eyes OG portrait series.
This edition uses 12 layers to create 623 unique 1/1 portrait artworks featuring 9 faces who have shaped the early days of the decentralized blockchain revolution. 

Vitalik Buterin
Andreas Antonopoulos
John McAfee
Edward Snowden
Julian Assange
Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss
Dalai Lama
Warren Buffett
Alan Turing

9 is the number of completion. It represents the end of this cycle and the beginning of the next cycle.

The edition number of 623 is a symbolic number that represents the first time I publically displayed any version of the Decentral Eyes series. A physical print version of the Vitalik Buterin portrait at the NAC crypto conference in San Francisco on 6/23/18 was the genesis release date.

What a long, strange trip it's been.

Named for the blend mode that inspired its creation, 'Multiply' makes liberal use of this digital composition method in its construction.

This piece consists of several hand-painted layers that overlap and mask each other in various ways. Each new 3x3 grid of colour reacts with those that came before it, before being wrapped in additional tone, border, and texture. The finished, fully-blended artwork has almost 50 billion unique possible combinations.

All artwork is 3840x3840 pixel resolution, and 5250 × 5250 'originals' are available to edition owners on request.

QmNtL3uZndikpyfwq3WQtvirucxgoHiP36xTuK64.name: GrandRising #149
QmNtL3uZndikpyfwq3WQtvirucxgoHiP36xTuK64.description:
Digging in the Blockchain (D.I.T.B.) has never felt so much like Diggin In The Crates (D.I.T.C.) This collection can be looked at as vinyl record warehouse named GRAND RISING, holding over 300,000 unique records, and the collectors can only leave with 420 copies. 

Then the warehouse is destroyed.

Using music inputs created by Rare Scrilla & RoomInEight, the collectors are participating in creating these compositions by hitting the Mint Button. Essentially making a collaboration with  Async's music generator. The artwork was created by Rare Scrilla and is based on vinyl record collecting, which Scrilla has been doing for over 20 years. 

You may find yourself with a coveted Obi Strip. Some familiar and non- familiar names may show up on the records as you peruse the collection. Scrilla, who's been a DJ, record producer, and artist his whole life, will sometimes put stickers on the vinyl, or doodles on the cover, sometimes the records get worn out, and sometimes while digging he may find a record with a graphic error or a different version of a song that was published and distributed by someone else. These details have been thoughtfully used while creating this collection. The easter eggs are plentiful.

Kane Mayfield and DJ Q-Bert both lend their skills on certain rarer tracks. You may find a legendary from Fake Sketch or K-Beta, maybe an epic guitar rendition featuring Glenn Yeah. The only way to pull these records from the crates is to hit that mint button.

Scrilla, also known for his Rare Pepes and Fake Rares, dating back to when he began "tokenizing" art and music using the Bitcoin blockchain in 2016, brings some of that to some of the art and music as well. But, of course, like the best Pepes should be- They are Rare outputs.

Some record are denominated in Sats, some in ETH, some in BTC, and of course yer local record dealer will sometimes deal in Pepecash.

There are plans to press up the best songs, curated by YOU - the collector, and put the album on Digital Streaming Platforms (DSPs.)  Let's see what transpires from it all.

QmNtihQzaktk4hpaxeCa8DNffb4fn2dTVgiwUCA9.description:
The Singularity Collection represents the culmination of the groundbreaking Holy Trinity series, pushing the boundaries of human-AI collaboration and offering a visionary glimpse into the future of humanity amidst the technological singularity.

Advanced AI algorithms within the collection tirelessly mine and synthesize vast troves of data surrounding the singularity phenomenon. By extracting insights from scientific research, historical trends, economic projections, and technological advancements, the AI bots generate accompanying narratives that contextualize each artwork within the grand tapestry of the singularity narrative.

The Singularity Collection invites collectors and enthusiasts to embark on an immersive journey of co-creation. With AI bots as creative partners, collectors can actively interact and influence the artistic direction of their acquired artworks. This interactive engagement fosters a profound connection between the artwork, the collector, and the evolving narrative of the singularity.

Incorporating Discord servers and LLCs, The Singularity Collection forms a vibrant ecosystem that nurtures community engagement and collaboration. These virtual meeting grounds facilitate dynamic discussions, collaborations, and the exchange of ideas among collectors, artists, and AI enthusiasts. Within these thriving communities, decentralized autonomous organizations (DAOs) take shape, empowering participants to co-create and shape the future of the collection.

The Singularity Collection stands as a testament to the limitless possibilities that arise from the convergence of human creativity and artificial intelligence. It immerses collectors in a journey through the depths of the singularity, where technology and humanity intertwine in a dance of innovation and imagination. Each artwork serves as a portal to an unfolding future, inviting collectors to embrace the transformative power of the singularity and become active participants in shaping our shared destiny.

QmNtk888XmVZbYjDy5hhoDpZTFoWzormjRn8Anfh.name: 3x3 #81
QmNtk888XmVZbYjDy5hhoDpZTFoWzormjRn8Anfh.description:
Named for the blend mode that inspired its creation, 'Multiply' makes liberal use of this digital composition method in its construction.

This piece consists of several hand-painted layers that overlap and mask each other in various ways. Each new 3x3 grid of colour reacts with those that came before it, before being wrapped in additional tone, border, and texture. The finished, fully-blended artwork has almost 50 billion unique possible combinations.

All artwork is 3840x3840 pixel resolution, and 5250 × 5250 'originals' are available to edition owners on request.

QmNuxompE38Cy4BR1hwcodPaSYbLLkotkuecihAN.name: Burning
QmNuxompE38Cy4BR1hwcodPaSYbLLkotkuecihAN.description:
Burning = The Urge To Create. There's always something brewing inside. Always an idea, an image or a plan to work on. Always a face to spend time with. To see the beauty and take the power to transform it into something else. I'm looking for unity in the World of a Scatterbrain. I flow through colors and find Peace inside my work. The progress, doing the work, the feeling when I step outside time. It's all captured in my work. Dense and Intense. Looking for details that light up and want to be discovered. Like diamonds in a mine.

The layers of this piece all have 2 states. The layer owners can choose which one will be visible. When Smoking, Holding, Staring and Flaying are together switched to State #2 they block the background image and become a New Piece. The layer owners have to work together if they want to see this piece. 


I want every layer owner to have the feeling they own something special that can also be shown just by itself. We all contribute to a larger system, but have our own thoughts and feelings too. I mean, we're all part of a family but we're also individuals. Like the transformers. 



Extra info:
I've burned the Base Drawing of this work in order to extracted value offline and added it to the online world. 

I set the drawing on fire in my garden and recorded the process. I've tokenized it and published it in an edition of 10 on Rarible and will give them away to a lucky few.

QmNwRGvKNiKsjwhYSjifa7x4hq6gEwFMnFHKf9wv.name: The Infiniverse
QmNwRGvKNiKsjwhYSjifa7x4hq6gEwFMnFHKf9wv.description:
If the many-worlds theory is correct; if the multiverse exists, then there are infinite universes existing "alongside" each other, each with its own unique set of laws of energy and physics. It's not likely that we'll ever get to understand, let alone see, these other universes, even if we did prove their existence. But since there would be INFINITE worlds - well, that leaves room even for my limited, human imagination...

Thus this "Infiniverse" is a small snapshot, taken from my mind, of what some of these worlds, and the portals that bridge them, might look like. It is also part of my "The First" series of sci-fi stories/pieces.

legendaryEditions.name: Mycelium
legendaryEditions.description:
La vida transcurre entre dos universos: el interno y el externo. Y mientras transitamos la intrincada linea que los separa, damos significado a aquello a lo que somos capaz de revivir. Nuestros recuerdos, como esporas, se esparcen entre ambos ¿Hasta donde llega aquello que imaginamos? ¿Como se transforma lo que somos en el andar? ¿Cuantas veces partimos? ¿Cuantas veces llegamos? ¿Cuántas veces somos?

Life takes place between two universes: the internal and the external. And while we walk the intricate line that separates them, we give meaning to what we are capable of resurrecting. Our memories, like spores, spread between the two. How far does what we imagine go? How does our journey transform what we are? How many times do we leave? How many times do we arrive? How many selves are we?

---

legendaryEditions.name: The Bryophytic Gate
legendaryEditions.description:
In this viseau, Ball-E has come upon an Infinigate in what they have dubbed the Magical Mangrove of Sector N4b1. They recognise the portal because their own kind accidentally created one many millennia ago - a gateway that bridges different universes. What they don't know is how this particular one could exist. The infinigate that The First created was a combination of incredibly advanced bio technology and a collapsing star, interacting in perplexing ways that even they (the species The First) are still trying to understand. 

"Tʜɪs sᴇᴇᴍs ᴛᴏ ʙᴇ, ᴀғᴛᴇʀ ᴀɴ ɪɴɪᴛɪᴀʟ sᴄᴀɴ, ᴏɴʟʏ ᴀ ᴄɪʀᴄʟᴇ ᴏғ ᴡᴏᴏᴅ ᴘᴇʀᴍᴇᴀᴛᴇᴅ ʙʏ ᴛʜᴇ ғɪʙʀᴏᴜs ʀᴏᴏᴛs ᴏғ ᴀɴ ᴜɴᴄᴀᴛᴀʟᴏɢᴜᴇᴅ ʙᴜᴛ ᴏᴛʜᴇʀᴡɪsᴇ ᴜɴɪɴᴛᴇʀᴇsᴛɪɴɢ sᴘᴇᴄɪᴇs ᴏғ ᴍᴏss. Iᴛs sɪᴢᴇ ɪs ᴀʟsᴏ ᴀ ᴘᴏɪɴᴛ ᴏғ ᴄᴏɴsɪᴅᴇʀᴀᴛɪᴏɴ. Iᴛ ᴄᴏᴜʟᴅ ɴᴏᴛ ʜᴀᴠᴇ ʙᴇᴇɴ ᴄʀᴇᴀᴛᴇᴅ ʙʏ ᴛʜᴇ sᴀᴍᴇ ɢʀᴀᴠɪᴛᴀᴛɪᴏɴᴀʟ ғᴏʀᴄᴇs ᴀs ᴏᴜʀs. Iᴛ ᴀᴘᴘᴇᴀʀs ᴛᴏ ʜᴀᴠᴇ ᴀᴄᴛɪᴠᴀᴛᴇᴅ ᴡɪᴛʜ ᴍʏ ᴀᴘᴘʀᴏxɪᴍᴀᴛɪᴏɴ. I ᴀᴍ ᴜɴsᴜʀᴇ ᴡʜᴇᴛʜᴇʀ ᴀᴘᴘʀᴏᴀᴄʜɪɴɢ ғᴜʀᴛʜᴇʀ ᴡᴏᴜʟᴅ ʙᴇ ᴘʀᴜᴅᴇɴᴛ, ʏᴇᴛ I ғᴇᴇʟ ᴄᴏᴍᴘᴇʟʟᴇᴅ ᴛᴏ ɢᴀᴛʜᴇʀ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴅᴀᴛᴀ."

This was a strange and interesting event in Ball-E's life: Up until now, they had never faced any danger, and had never even thought of the notion (as they used to be part of the collective First). This was the first time they found themselves considering their own safety, as an individual entity, while pursuing their directives. This surprised them.

HISTORY:
A long time ago, Ball-E was marooned on a planet discovered recently by The First, an alien species of which they are, or were, a part of (one of their Archiver units).

Having gotten stuck in a crevice, the collective left without them, leaving them alone on the planet with only their own, new independent mind for company.

While struggling with existential angst, they made the decision to tour and catalogue the planet, as was their original purpose, but this time for their own sake.

QmNwaP257aMtmHjpzjoEu3iPv7tLo7uqUCrPM62H.name: Danktone S1E3 #1307
QmNwaP257aMtmHjpzjoEu3iPv7tLo7uqUCrPM62H.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

QmNx18R2zbfA4W2xoTnQK829dueyWixEvHfKdHNd.name: Deathless #81
QmNx18R2zbfA4W2xoTnQK829dueyWixEvHfKdHNd.description:
In the beginning, there was nothing.

 The world was empty and void, black and grey,  shade and dusk. Nothing moved, nothing shifted, all was owned by The Dark. But nature is more powerful, more unknowable, more unpredictable, than any of us can imagine, and so one day, defying all odds, among The Dark, a child was born. One that was different. One that, they knew, was dangerous. 

Her true name is lost to history and the pages it was first written on. But us, we know her as Light, the first of the spectrum, the mother of all colours. As she grew, in strength and wisdom, The Dark grew more afraid, more weary of this new child in their ranks. It was why till this day the shadows fear the sun. 

Soon, a plan was hatched, to destroy their daughter, their abominable creation. A dagger of Obsidian was made, moulded from the darkest metals, the blackest materials, all to down their biggest threat. Sensing danger, Light did the only thing she could: she went to the mountains of Prisma, at the edge of all they knew, and jumped, scattering herself, her essence into 7 different parts. Her children. 

They were old and young, large and small, all with their different temperaments. These were the first of those who would wage war on their mother’s behalf. 

And we, called them The Deathless. 

The ones who didn’t die. 

The ones who had never lived. 
.
The Deathless is my hit 1/1 series, exploring the depth of color and their origins. In my Async genesis, I take that concept and turn it over on its head, creating, for the first time, an expansive canvas for everyone to explore the story I began three years ago.

QmNxY4w6W1RWEqCF5VRGSnG3rMn5CQMWBbZkP7Kh.description:
Digging in the Blockchain (D.I.T.B.) has never felt so much like Diggin In The Crates (D.I.T.C.) This collection can be looked at as vinyl record warehouse named GRAND RISING, holding over 300,000 unique records, and the collectors can only leave with 420 copies. 

Then the warehouse is destroyed.

Using music inputs created by Rare Scrilla & RoomInEight, the collectors are participating in creating these compositions by hitting the Mint Button. Essentially making a collaboration with  Async's music generator. The artwork was created by Rare Scrilla and is based on vinyl record collecting, which Scrilla has been doing for over 20 years. 

You may find yourself with a coveted Obi Strip. Some familiar and non- familiar names may show up on the records as you peruse the collection. Scrilla, who's been a DJ, record producer, and artist his whole life, will sometimes put stickers on the vinyl, or doodles on the cover, sometimes the records get worn out, and sometimes while digging he may find a record with a graphic error or a different version of a song that was published and distributed by someone else. These details have been thoughtfully used while creating this collection. The easter eggs are plentiful.

Kane Mayfield and DJ Q-Bert both lend their skills on certain rarer tracks. You may find a legendary from Fake Sketch or K-Beta, maybe an epic guitar rendition featuring Glenn Yeah. The only way to pull these records from the crates is to hit that mint button.

Scrilla, also known for his Rare Pepes and Fake Rares, dating back to when he began "tokenizing" art and music using the Bitcoin blockchain in 2016, brings some of that to some of the art and music as well. But, of course, like the best Pepes should be- They are Rare outputs.

Some record are denominated in Sats, some in ETH, some in BTC, and of course yer local record dealer will sometimes deal in Pepecash.

There are plans to press up the best songs, curated by YOU - the collector, and put the album on Digital Streaming Platforms (DSPs.)  Let's see what transpires from it all.

QmNxi262WmmMk8ZuvToqfMRXfEdeewTCvo28zNiq.description:
On this episode we are honored to speak with artist and crypto art community activist Matt Kane! Matt is a self taught programmer who came to coding as a way to better actualize his artist visions through his own custom software. His work features dense multi-layered works that bring to mind complex, intricate, mesh-like, webs or networks. Matt is perhaps best known for his tremendously successful 2021 Art Blocks project “Gazers.” With Gazers, the works respond to the cycles of the moon and are perpetually shifting, making these works collectors want to live with and regularly revisit.   

In this episode, we discuss Matt’s journey from “lurker” to leader in the Cryptoart movement. Matt is candid about early successes and struggles to make it as an artist and the positive opportunities Cryptoart opened up for him. We learn where his interest in currency as a theme in his art stems from and his discovery of crypto. He also shares his love of art history and how analog painters like Monet serve as inspiration for his digital works. Matt shares an important story detailing how he collaborated with other important members of the crypto art community in 2020 to successfully lobby for a minimum secondary resale standard for artists. The Dankness is grateful to Matt for sharing so much of his story, it’s a special and insightful conversation, and we hope you find it as engaging as we did!   

You should absolutely follow Matt Kane at @MattKaneArtist and you can learn more about his unique and engaging body of work on his website mattkane.com.

To keep up with the podcast follow @thedanknessxyz on Twitter. Sickles is on Twitter at @dan_sickles and you can keep up with his amazing documentary at @newherexyz as it evolves. Artnome lives on Twitter at @artnome and his company ClubNFT, which helps collectors protect and discover NFTs, is at @club_nft.

QmNy3cbm2Bt9RXbvSq5KyeCxTE1oFPBPETBCdP5R.description:
Climate change is the largest looming threat to humanity. According to the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE) in New Delhi, our annual carbon dioxide (CO2)
emissions have grown by about 70 times since the pre-industrial era, reaching nearly 36.4 gigatonnes (Gt) in 2019. Unless we bring them down to 18.22 Gt by 2030, we are headed for catastrophic climate events. 

The first classical Music Blueprint on Async, "Element" translates the sounds of the natural world into the language of the string quartet with two types: before and after the destruction of natural resources
caused by industrialization, colonization, and overconsumption. Each layer of the string quartet (violin 1, violin 2, viola, and cello) has four different states (fire, water, air, and earth) that are each played differently. 

EARTH - matter of fact, march-like, full and deep tone
AIR - otherworldly, harmonics, ponticello, airy tone
WATER - legato, glissandi, pizzicato, syncopated 
FIRE - staccato, tremolo, agitated, chopping

A portion of sales from this project will be donated to the Clean Air Task Force (www.catf.us), who work to curb air pollution in all its forms through regulation at the US state and federal levels.

Composed by Kaitlyn Raitz 
Performed by the Atwood Quartet
Recorded and mixed by Chris Leidhecker
“After” sound designing by Eric Wright
Art by Jana Stýblová

QmNymAEsVdi91HnsFtHA8kVSFfkkeFmLKvqvvhJV.description:
In the beginning, there was nothing.

 The world was empty and void, black and grey,  shade and dusk. Nothing moved, nothing shifted, all was owned by The Dark. But nature is more powerful, more unknowable, more unpredictable, than any of us can imagine, and so one day, defying all odds, among The Dark, a child was born. One that was different. One that, they knew, was dangerous. 

Her true name is lost to history and the pages it was first written on. But us, we know her as Light, the first of the spectrum, the mother of all colours. As she grew, in strength and wisdom, The Dark grew more afraid, more weary of this new child in their ranks. It was why till this day the shadows fear the sun. 

Soon, a plan was hatched, to destroy their daughter, their abominable creation. A dagger of Obsidian was made, moulded from the darkest metals, the blackest materials, all to down their biggest threat. Sensing danger, Light did the only thing she could: she went to the mountains of Prisma, at the edge of all they knew, and jumped, scattering herself, her essence into 7 different parts. Her children. 

They were old and young, large and small, all with their different temperaments. These were the first of those who would wage war on their mother’s behalf. 

And we, called them The Deathless. 

The ones who didn’t die. 

The ones who had never lived. 
.
The Deathless is my hit 1/1 series, exploring the depth of color and their origins. In my Async genesis, I take that concept and turn it over on its head, creating, for the first time, an expansive canvas for everyone to explore the story I began three years ago.

Named for the blend mode that inspired its creation, 'Multiply' makes liberal use of this digital composition method in its construction.

This piece consists of several hand-painted layers that overlap and mask each other in various ways. Each new 3x3 grid of colour reacts with those that came before it, before being wrapped in additional tone, border, and texture. The finished, fully-blended artwork has almost 50 billion unique possible combinations.

All artwork is 3840x3840 pixel resolution, and 5250 × 5250 'originals' are available to edition owners on request.

Senses is a healing audio-visual poetic journey through the mind-body and spirit that is based on 100 original poems written/performed by David Bianchi inspired by the five human senses.

Each piece incorporates generative psychedelic art by Dogan Demir coded from data from David's poetic recordings, as well as healing Solfeggio frequency music by EDM producer 
PLS&TY .

The owner of each piece will hold the commercial re-sale and publishing rights to David's poetry as well as access to metaverse immersive sound baths and IRL experiences in major markets.

What is it about sight that changes point of view?

But the eye sees and the heart wanders,
Truly touching,
How sight makes the heart grow fonder.

The beauty of it all
Sunlight
To Sundown

Fascinating how we all see the same through the magic iris
But the same principles that create the magic of eye color
Sadly divide us,
Maybe someday we’ll see details within?
The color of the beauty of our eyes,
Matches the beauty,
Of our skin.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:

Colors, textures and the shape of things.
But what about energy?
An important question in a subjective reality,

Even a blind man,

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
Most of us can see up to one million shades of color.

Some 100 million - an anatomical wonder-
They say our eyes are most sensitive to bright green.

I tend to enjoy a cool shade of blue.
What’s so special about your favorite color,
Is it’s yours,
And only yours,
And particular,
To you.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Sometimes I want to have vision,
Sometimes I want to see,
Sometimes I want to be visual,
Sometimes I want to be seen.
My eyes tell what’s real,
My heart tells me the truth.
But there is something about a lie,
That people can always see through.

legendaryEditions.name: Senses LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
The soul is an open book if you look one in the eyes,
But gaining the trust of one for that time is harder to find,
Simply glancing is not looking,
And looking is not seeing,
Who loves you enough?
To allow you close enough,
To truly read their meaning?

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
The next time you see a pretty color,
Pause and reflect on yet another.
Tap into the feeling that the color emits,
Remember a moment associated with it.
Escape for a while and let the feeling free,
Fill your heart with gratitude,
And your ability to see.

legendaryEditions.name: Sight LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Most of the time man gets in the way,
Of being able to see gifts on a sun shiny day,
Smog and smoke block our view --
Otherwise, we could see 20km through
Without the smog,
At sea it’s the curvature that blocks the view of the earth,
But we all love a beach sunset,
For whatever it’s worth.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Perfumes are made from the finest ingredients.
Flowers and oils that create a magical experience,
A way to escape,
A way to cast a spell,
A way to make the opposite sex feel love and overwhelmed.
A way to create allure and sultry mystery,
An alchemic mix of sexuality and chemistry.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Oil slicks,
Landfills,
Turpentine,
Burnt grease.
Burned rubber,
Melting plastic,
Tear gas,
Factories,
There is nothing comfortable about the smell these create,
It’s time we re-think the damage we really make.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
We can smell danger,
We can smell the holidays,
We can smell romance,
And love in the air ways.
We can smell comfort,
We can smell sex,
We can smell happiness,
And we can smell death,
Signals of life that smell helps us find,
Signals of humanity,
Memories painted on the mind.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
The smell of herbs always makes me smile.
Parsley, sage, rosemary and thyme,
Aloe, mint, lavender mist,
Can take you to a place you’ve always loved and miss.
There is such a comfort in certain scents,
The fabric of our stories,
In olfactory language.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Some smells feel romantic,
Some remind you of danger,
Some place you in a resentment,
The festering of anger.
Some will make you feel confused,
Yet some remind you of home,
Some will wrap you up in love,
Even when you’re alone.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
The mystery of the scent of a woman’s perfume,
Such a welcoming introduction as one walks in the room.
Knowing that someone smells so sweet,
It’s spell binding sometimes and makes men weak.
The power of a woman before she even speaks,
The strength of her aura,
Is bold,
Yet discreet.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
I catch the scent of a memory,
I am quickly drawn back,
I catch the scent of that memory and mind quickly reacts.
I don’t recall the place,
Or even the time exact,
But I do remember how I felt,
The day that scent
Brought me back.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
Breathe in deep,
Smell the air,
Take a big breath out,
Release it there.
Breathe in gently,
Is the smell still there?

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
The sweet smell of pine,
Awakens the imagination,
Gives us a piece of mother nature’s perfume.
The smell of Christmas,
A relaxing sigh,
A warm feeling in the winter,
Even when it’s cold outside.

legendaryEditions.name: Smell LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Smell brings joy,
It can also bring pain.
It can bring you the memories of days gone,
And make you ponder on what remains.
It can awaken a thought that has left you for years,
The sweet smells of life,
I smother my pillow with the smell of her,
So when I’m alone,
I feel alright.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Sounds baths calm anxiety,
And deeply relax the mind,
Reduce stress,
Improve sleep,
And lower blood pressure at the same time.
But it takes a willingness,
A willingness to pause,
Pause long enough--
To receive the gift of it all.
Some sounds need stillness...
To actually heal,
The noise in the mind,
That is often is too real.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
There is a place we all used to go long back when we were kids,
That secret hiding place where dragons and fairies lived.
Laughing papa bears,
And galloping unicorns,
Lions that told you bedtime stories.
And genies lived in a lamp.
We could hear them all so vividly
Way - back - then,
Now my quiet places are quiet,
Not full of joy and fantasy,
I sometimes wish my imagination,
Could bring those sounds back to me.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
Sound can be intimate,
Sound can be aggressive,
It can be delicate,
It can be sensitive,
It can be hurtful,
It can be sweet,
There so many ways that we can describe
The sounds of the world,
One wave at a time.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
Music Therapy,
The healing of sound.
A violin, A cello,
Hummingbirds in the background,
There is scientific proof that sound truly heals.
It can change the structure of water,
And calm an angry mind,
We should honor the gift of sound,
One note,
One chime,
One wood wind at a time.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Mechanically sound is just vibration in the air
It is present in all places, it is present everywhere
It changes based on the barriers it passes through.
Or the distance it must reach,
Be a gun shot or a speech,
Each has its characteristics vibrating in the air,
Inch by inch,
The vibration everywhere.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
An Operatic voice,
Concerts that rock,
Hip Hop classics,
Harmonizing du-wop,
A Funky Jazz tune,
And pop music hits,
The scratch of fingernails on a mean guitar riff!
Let the classical music play,
Let the new music shine,
We sent it to outer space,
Because it’s the stamp of mankind.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Can you recollect the first thing you ever heard?
I know I can’t,
Was it an activity or a word?
Was it the sound of my mother’s beating heart?
I like to believe that.
That it was love from the start.
A gentle heart thump bu-bump bu-bump
That reminder of life,
Love in every pump.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
If a tree falls in the forest, and no one is around to hear it,
Does it make a sound?
Can we be so arrogant to think it doesn’t if we’re not around?
We know a butterfly shakes the air even though you can’t hear it,
Do you hear the voice of God if you’re silent in your spirit?
The truth is sound is... all up to you
Your perception will always remind you...
Which sounds ring true.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
Children laugh.
People play,
Puppies bark,
A song today,
A cricket chirps,
A crashing wave,
A mothers hum,
All in the airwaves.

legendaryEditions.name: Sound LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
Sounds can be familiar,
Comforting at ease.
Sounds can remind us of trauma,
Buried deep within our psyche.
Sounds can produce joy,
Sadness and grief.
Even the sound of silence can be loud,
If you listen deep.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of drinking water is so elusive.
Some say it taste like nothing,
Yet it’s life-giving nectar.
Add sugar and call it a soft drink,
Add some salt and it disinfects.
Tea and the sunshine brings families together to laugh, hug, and reflect.
Add some lemon and its crisp.
Add cucumber and its refreshing.
That magic thing called water,
The elixir of everything.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Without the nose taste is incomplete.
Everything in the body is connected so intricately.
Every part so interdependent,
Taste relies on the nose.
The simple smell of food,
That makes taste,
Feel like home.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
I love the funny faces people make,
When something in their mouth like a strange or awkward taste?
A sour taste that’s guaranteed to contort the face!
A putrid taste will make you spit it out in a haste.
A not so bad...But I can’t spit it out because people are around face?
That Mom I told you so I hate this flavor face!
Tell-tale signs of what’s happening on the tongue,
People don’t say a word,
And their faces come undone.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of a lover is oh so sweet.
Often time that taste can live in your heart for weeks,
Wouldn’t you love to box it up, and have it for keeps?
Something to bring you joy,
When your heart is feeling weak?
But that taste can be bitter if the day when love goes south,
The sour of anger,
Broken hearts,
Angst in your mouth.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of sea water,
The warmth of tea,
The sweet of maple syrup fresh dripped fresh from a tree,
The marmalade of summer,
The pumpkin pie of fall,
The cocoa of winter,
And the lemonade of spring
Just a few of life’s flavors,
That remind us,
That life is just beginning.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
Taste is subjective.
Some like pepper,
Some like salt,
Some like sweet,
Some none of the above.
Some like wine,
Some like juice,
Some like garlic,
Some neither of the two,
I like my taste,
Because it’s mine.
Since you like yours,
We’ll get along just fine.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
Nine thousand taste buds send signals to the mind,
The mind interprets what our taste will find.
These signals they vary depending where on the tongue
Nine thousand taste buds when we are young
Explosion of flavor,
Explosion of youth!
How sweet life is,
When life is a sweet tooth.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
We often describe moments through taste.
The sweet taste of success,
The sour taste of loss.
The bitter taste of jealousy,
The delicate taste of love.
We know our tastes so well,
We attach them to things that have none.
Familiar.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
Some candy is bittersweet-
And that’s a good thing,

But when life is bittersweet it’s not a happy ending,
How is one good?
And another full of pain?
I’m just a poet.
I’ll leave that to you to explain.

legendaryEditions.name: Taste LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
The taste of a lover does more than last.
It imprints a memory that aches when you fast.
Fast from their salt,
Fast from their wet,
Fast from their cologne,
Until your tongue can reset.
But your mind won’t forget the taste on your tongue.
Your thoughts might miss their air in your lung.
Long after the taste the mind makes it last,
Until you forget it all,
And taste brand new,
At last.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #1
legendaryEditions.description:
Your hands on my skin make me feel whole.
The gentle graze of your skin,
Awakens my soul,
The soft wet of your mouth arouses me wet.
Touch me again,
Help me never forget.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #2
legendaryEditions.description:
Blind men use touch,
And read without eyes,
There are three thousand receptors that don’t let hands lie.
These receptors reply to pressure of touch,
Packed under the surface of the skin,
To tell the brain what is enough.
Enough to tell,
Enough to lie,
A blind man will catch you with the touch without an eye.
See the eyes often times can deceive what is real,
Use the pressure points of touch,
If their eyes cheat and steal.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #3
legendaryEditions.description:
Now I sob,
Emotional hurt,
Now I’m sore because of your words.
Now I ache from your decisions pain.
The feelings of actions,
The weight of lifes remains,
Living with me,
And my bed is unkept.
I’ve been cross eyed with pain,
Long before you left.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #4
legendaryEditions.description:
A Mothers hand,
A graze that soothes,
Running water,
Golden sun,
And a bronzing mood,
A whisper ear,
A note of grace,
Calm my heart.
While I palpitate in place.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #5
legendaryEditions.description:
Finger tips,
Toes,
Cheeks and lips,
Elbows and knees,
Ears and hips.
Heels and private parts,
A gentle nudge,
A push or a wrestle,
The parts of the body,
That make touch so damn special.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #6
legendaryEditions.description:
There’s a burn that comes with a heart break.
Not a physical burn,
An emotional burn that your heart can’t take.
Feeling can be internal or external to the touch.
We can also be touched inside for loving too much.
We protect that place as we grow older,
To save us from the pain of being pushed over.
But the reward of a loving touch is far too great,
To live in fear everyday of a speculative fate.
So we take the pain and feel again,
Knowing that the touch of love,
Is always a win.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #7
legendaryEditions.description:
I feel you drip,
In my hand.
I feel you kiss,
Shake where you stand.
You feel me shake,
I grow and stand.
I press your wetness in my hand.
You feel my mouth,
Kiss and drip.
I feel your breath on my lips.
I’m home alone,
I feel you still,
Lingering moments,
I’ll forever feel.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #8
legendaryEditions.description:
Bubble wrap,
Warm Soup,
Smooth Silk,
Cold brew.
Soft fur,
A pets nose,
Warm sand,
And comfy winter clothes.
All things that are comfy every time to the touch,
The little things that remind us,
That life is enough.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #9
legendaryEditions.description:
A tickle can be pleasant.
Or overbearing,
A graze of a fingertip is good from someone caring.
A graze from a stranger can make you uneasy.
The touch of a lover can relax you and have meaning.
A touch from a ex can rouse up resentment.
A poke from a partner can bring laughs and comfortable presence.
Touches have different meanings depending on the delivery,
Fascinating how the same thing can be comforting or discomforting,
Context.

legendaryEditions.name: Touch LGD #10
legendaryEditions.description:
I am awakened when we touch,
Weak and feeble,
Your energy pulses through our electricity collides,
I am alive.
I react to your moves,
Run your tongue on my chest,
Breath on my neck,
Feel my spit -- Feel me whole.
I collapse on myself,
I discovered my soul.
